prompt: Our NestJS backend (module 17, end-to-end security) pulls a third-party signing secret from a Vault-style store to sign outbound API calls — see the `SecretsService` below, which is invoked on every incoming request. Production is reporting three symptoms at once: roughly 40ms of extra latency added to every single request, an audit log so flooded with per-request "secret read" events that the real audit trail is drowned out, and a full 30-second service outage when the secret store had a brief blip. Walk me through how you'd optimize this secret's lifecycle so all three symptoms go away, and make sure to also cover how credential rotation would still work, and how you'd want boot-time failures to behave differently from a failure that happens mid-run.
